verdict.rationale: All evidence describes merchant-side integration (Braintree/PayPal accepting agent-initiated payments, cart APIs, catalog sync, refund/dispute tools) — nothing shows a consumer-facing wallet that an AI-native user funds and controls, with balance visibility, for their own agent to spend from. The closest mechanism (delegated Braintree tokens) is a single-use, merchant-scoped checkout credential generated per transaction, not a user-provisioned funded wallet.
